svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-startup-budget-stack; chart type: stacked_comparison; title: Fund the work before the first distribution; subtitle: Illustrative $10,000 business cash stack; chapter number: 4; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD; four additive components total $10,000 for one pilot scenario. Owner living expenses, income tax and ongoing salaries are excluded; obtain local quotes.; caption: The cash reserve is unspent liquidity, not a fee expense. A startup allowance does not fund a two-person payroll indefinitely.; stages: label: Setup and review; value: $2,500; numeric value: 2500.0; detail: Formation, initial engagement review and insurance allowance; actual costs depend on services and jurisdiction.; label: Tools and records; value: $1,000; numeric value: 1000.0; detail: Initial secure case system, records access and communication tools for a bounded pilot.; label: Pilot case work; value: $1,500; numeric value: 1500.0; detail: Certified documents, postage and contract research across successful and rejected cases.; label: Uncommitted reserve; value: $5,000; numeric value: 5000.0; detail: Liquidity for delays and rework; keep separate from projected receivables and claimant funds.
